svg.title: Wireframe 01b: Canvas in Learn mode
svg.desc: Canvas screen during a lesson. The step card sits above the side panel with the step number, up to 80 words of text, and Back, Next and Exit lesson. The exercise step names the one change and the one place to make it (set Capacity to 2): the block, till, has the Learn highlight ring and a Step 3 of 5 tag, the Capacity field in the side panel has the same ring, and the step asks What do you think will happen? with a single choice, after which Run is enabled; other blocks keep full contrast.
svg.text: In the side panel of Till, set
What do you think will happen?
Run is enabled once you have chosen.
